hb:GenInfo.hb:Description: Registered controller that visits three absolute targets using existing legacy Drone move PDUs.
hb:GenInfo.hb:Manufacturer: Local Hakoniwa Business Pack implementation; legal manufacturer not assigned
hb:GenInfo.hb:Examples: Validated Windows 11 + WSL2 three-point simulated Drone composition

hb:IDnType.hb:IdentifierPolicy: Locally generated UUID URN; not an ISO-assigned provider/module identifier

hb:CatalogReferences.hb:CatalogReference: Recipe-local controller using the cataloged simulator; no standalone controller catalog entry is asserted.

hb:Variable.hb:Description: Request and response share one channel. Current Python converter emits 80 bytes; writes are zero-padded to channel capacity.
hb:Variable.hb:Field: Completion code; 0 is accepted by this controller

hb:Variable.hb:Description: Request and response share one channel. Current Python converter emits 80 bytes; writes are zero-padded to channel capacity.
hb:Variable.hb:Field: Completion code; 0 is accepted by this controller

hb:Status.hb:Description: Declared states/observations, not a live status snapshot or a newly implemented status service.

hb:Services.hb:Service: asset_register, start, on_initialize, on_simulation_step, on_reset; no external-client initialization.
Single outstanding request; wait for completion and minimum send interval before next target; reset restores the first target.

hb:Infra.hb:Requirement: Windows 11 host; Ubuntu 24.04 WSL2 x86_64 execution
Shared compatible Foundation Core / PDU definitions / isolated mmap domain
One Conductor owned by Drone service; do not start a second owner
Launcher before_start asset; hako-cmd start begins simulation time
Foundation CPython 3.12, SOABI-tagged hakopy and hakoniwa_pdu from the same Foundation

hb:SafeSecure.hb:Constraint: Requires legacy-api Drone mode and takeoff completed before the first move.
No concurrent writer arbitration; only one move-command sender.
Interval is simulation time between sends, not guaranteed arrival duration.
Timeout does not cancel an in-flight movement.

hb:Modelling.hb:Description: Static integration datasheet for the tested profile; no safety certification, formal model or timing guarantee is claimed.

hb:ExecutableForm.hb:PathReference: Resolved recipe runtime root supplied by the deployment environment
Selected compatible Foundation root supplied by the deployment environment
Compatible Drone distribution root supplied by the deployment environment
Business Pack checkout root supplied by the deployment environment

hb:Evidence.hb:Verification: Registration, PDU movement and/or composition evidence is scoped to the cited local tests. Full declared interface coverage is not claimed.
hb:Evidence.hb:Conformance: ISO Annex B exact tags, types, cardinalities and official XSD validation remain unverified. All XML elements use an explicitly local namespace.
